OK About Us About Us Discomp has been operating on the market since 1999, initially focusing on the sale and custom assembly of PC systems. Over the following years, we specialized in the sale and service of networking equipment for both license-free and licensed frequency bands. We became a distributor for most of the world's leading WiFi manufacturers . Our efforts also include pre-sales and after-sales support for our partners, including training and other activities that promote mutual growth. Since 2012, we have also specialized in IP Security . We are able to provide wireless solutions od 900 MHz do 80 GHz including accessories and technical support . Our customers are primarily ISPs and major ICT distributors from around the world. Company Milestones 2025 We became an authorized reseller of Tachyon Networks, an innovative manufacturer of 60 GHz fixed wireless solutions for PTP and PTMP connectivity. This partnership expanded our offering with high-speed outdoor radios, PoE switches, and cloud-managed systems capable of delivering more than 2 Gbps over distances of up to 6 km without cabling, providing our customers in the WISP, CCTV, and enterprise networking sectors with reliable and affordable broadband solutions. We established a partnership with Wi-Tek, a provider of advanced wireless technologies from Wireless-Tek Technology Limited focused on small and medium-sized businesses.
